queries.result: United States local-language context is English; the separate localized query returned the same official City of Riverside and Riverside County parcel-service leads.

registryBasis: Official City of Riverside cadastral MapServer and Riverside County Assessor parcel MapServer expose public parcel layers and geometry queries; the county layer is explicitly maintained as a taxable-parcel polygon layer.

verifiedParcelResponse.source: Riverside County Assessor OpenData PARCELS layer

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City of Riverside cadastral parcel layer is city-scoped; Riverside County Assessor PARCELS layer is county-scoped and described as taxable parcels replicated from the CountyGIS geodatabase.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous service metadata and one exact-WUP-point polygon response were verified. Citywide completeness, update lineage beyond service descriptions, and all parcel attributes were not independently audited.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: County parcel query returned one polygon containing the exact WUP coordinate; City of Riverside parcel query also returned one polygon with native OBJECTID 44648.
geometryDecision.retainedProperties: Only canonical native identity id is retained in GeoJSON; raw source fields are not retained.

remainingUncertainty: The exact point is a bounded qualification sample, not evidence of citywide parcel completeness. The City service query initially rejected resultRecordCount pagination; the retry without that parameter succeeded. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
